content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**What changed:** the single operative edit to §21.1 now uses the preferred temporal anchor — "in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim" — instead of the event-based lookback, and keeps the USD 1,000,000 floor and the "paid or payable" basis. It also removes the "first Order Form" restriction and clarifies the measure as "the fees (including subscription fees) ... under this Agreement and all Order Forms" in lowercase, so Vendor cannot re-import the §1.5 definition ("Fees" = the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) and re-create an illusory cap.

**Unchanged:** mutuality, §21.2's mutual indirect/consequential exclusion and direct-damages characterisation, §21.3's Excluded Claims list and the payment-obligation carve-out — all mapped as already_met with verbatim quotes. Minimality validated ok:true with a single replace.
